deployments_detail.use: Digital mortgage/loan application platform leveraging open banking, AI and analytics to streamline new loan processing and workflow, targeting approval-in-principle in under an hour. [CreditLogic]

Credit-risk modelling on SAS: PTSB staff presented at SAS Innovate 2025 on enhancing Expected Credit Loss (ECL) model performance by leveraging SAS CAS in SAS Viya, migrating from SAS 9 to modernise banking model development. [SAS (Viya / CAS)]

Real-time fraud detection and transaction monitoring using adaptive behavioural analytics / machine learning. PTSB deployed Featurespace's ARIC Risk Hub to build individual customer behaviour profiles, detect anomalies in real time, comply with PSD2, and reduce false positives while improving operational efficiency. [Featurespace (ARIC Risk Hub)]

AI/ML anti-smishing mobile protection. PTSB launched 'PTSB Protect' (powered by Expleo, ExpleoNora / ExpleoProtectUS) inside its banking app; the opt-in tool uses AI and machine learning to scan inbound SMS and detect/block fraudulent links. PTSB says it was the first bank to deploy such technology. [Expleo (ExpleoNora / ExpleoProtectUS)]
deployments_detail.value: 55% reduction in fake website clicks by customers since launch (Oct 2023)

deployments_detail.use: 'Foresight' fraud scoring tool added to fraud-monitoring strategies for card transactions, enhancing real-time fraud scoring/detection in the card payments space. [none named]

AI-infused complaints handling. Insight 2 Value helped PTSB embed artificial intelligence and advanced case-management capabilities into its complaints process, built on IBM Business Automation Workflow, to transform complaint interactions into lasting customer relationships. [IBM (Business Automation Workflow) + Insight 2 Value]
In-app customer service chatbot available 24/7 in the PTSB mobile banking app to handle common queries (e.g., PIN issues) and route customers to human advisers. [none named]
SAS Customer Intelligence deployment (marketing analytics / customer decisioning) with PTSB listed as an implementer in SAS/Accenture banking case-study materials. [SAS (Customer Intelligence)]
